user.title: MMH MCP
user.description: Mounts an MCP endpoint at /api/mmh_mcp. Choose what the tools may do; the My Magic Home gateway adds per-person roles on top.

data.allow_write: Allow write tools (call_service, set_state, registry updates, config-entry mutations)
data.allow_destructive: Allow destructive tools (delete state, remove entries, registry delete)
data.allow_fire_event: Allow firing arbitrary events on the event bus
data.rate_limit_per_minute: Max MCP requests per minute per token (0 = unlimited)

gateway.title: Connect to the MMH gateway
gateway.description: Paste the pairing code generated in the gateway panel (mcp.mymagichome.com.br/admin) and check the site details. A dedicated 'MMH Gateway' user and token are created automatically. Leave the code empty to connect later from the integration options.

data.site_slug: Site slug: lowercase, no spaces (e.g. business). Spaces and accents are converted.
data.ha_url: Public address of this Home Assistant

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one MMH MCP instance is supported.
